home.name: Home
home.heroTitle: Your Whole Vortex Toolkit, in One Place
home.heroBody: Pick a tool to get started. Everything here works on collections you've already installed in Vortex—rebuild them faster, keep your Ignored and Disabled mods through an update, sort out conflict rules, and see how it all went.

merge.name: Merge Plugins
merge.heroBody:
Even with light mods, Skyrim's 4,096-plugin limit can sneak up on a large load order. Pick plugins across your collections to bundle them into a single file—freeing up light slots without opening xEdit.

You can preview everything going into the merge first, and the tool will automatically mark the new bundle as a light plugin whenever it fits.
merge.cardDesc: Bundle several plugins into one file and free up load-order slots.

rebuild.name: Rebuild Collection
rebuild.heroTitle: Rebuild Collections in Minutes, Not Hours
rebuild.heroBody: Skip Vortex's slow archive-install process entirely! This tool re-extracts an already-installed collection's mods directly into your staging folder—same result, dramatically faster. Review exactly what would change before anything happens, then let it run while you do something else.
rebuild.cardDesc: Re-extract an installed collection straight into staging—same result, dramatically faster.

sync.name: Update Collection (Classic)
sync.heroTitle: Update Without Redoing Your Mod Cleanup
sync.heroBody: Updating a collection in Vortex often resets your carefully-set Ignored and Disabled mods back to their defaults. This tool remembers exactly how you had things set and restores it after the update, so that cleanup work never has to happen twice. Work through the steps below in order — you'll hop over to Vortex between some of them, and your place here is saved while you do.
sync.cardDesc: Keep your Ignored and Disabled mods exactly as you set them after an update.

rules-generator.name: Rules Generator
rules-generator.heroTitle: Skip Re-Resolving Conflicts You Already Fixed
rules-generator.heroBody: Updated to a new collection? Chances are you already spent time getting load-order rules just right in the old one. This tool matches mods between both collections and copies those rules straight across, so you're not stuck resolving the exact same conflicts twice. Review every match below before applying anything to Vortex.
rules-generator.cardDesc: Copy the conflict rules you already fixed from an old collection to its update.

update-collection-v2.name: Update Collection
update-collection-v2.heroBody: Check your installed collections for updates and review exactly what a new revision changes—mods removed, updated, or added. Then apply those updates for real: complete extraction, genuine deployment, and all your Ignored and Disabled mods and collection rules carried over untouched.
update-collection-v2.cardDesc: Check for updates, review exactly what changes, and apply removals/updates for real — your Ignored/Disabled mods and rules stay put.

remove-collection.name: Safe Collection Removal
remove-collection.heroTitle: Remove a Collection Without Breaking What Else Uses It
remove-collection.heroBody: Removing a collection in Vortex can easily wipe out mods that your other collections are still using behind the scenes. This tool checks your entire setup first, highlights every shared mod, and lets you choose individually what to keep or delete. You can safely clear out old collections without worrying about breaking anything else.
remove-collection.cardDesc: Checks for mods shared with your other collections before removing anything, so nothing else breaks.

report-stats.name: Stats
report-stats.heroTitle: See Every Rebuild at a Glance
report-stats.heroBody: Track how every collection you've rebuilt has performed over time, and instantly spot which mods still need attention right now. No more digging through individual run logs one at a time to piece together the full picture.
report-stats.cardDesc: See how every rebuild performed, and what still needs attention.

report-workthrough.name: Work Through
report-workthrough.heroTitle: Work Through Every Problem Mod, One by One
report-workthrough.heroBody: Instead of hunting through separate run logs for what still needs fixing, this report gathers every problem mod across every collection into one checklist. Fix resolvable mismatches and missing archives right here; check off anything else as you handle it in Vortex yourself—your progress sticks around until a fresh rerun clears it.
report-workthrough.cardDesc: Gather every problem mod across every collection into one checklist.

report-updatecompare.name: Update Compare
report-updatecompare.heroTitle: See Exactly What an Update Changed
report-updatecompare.heroBody: After running Update Collection, get a clear before-and-after comparison of your mods—what stayed, what got added, and what got removed—so you're never left guessing what an update actually did.
report-updatecompare.cardDesc: See a clear before-and-after of what an update added, kept, and removed.

report-rulesgen.name: Rules Generator Report
report-rulesgen.heroBody: See at a glance which mods already have their conflict rules copied over correctly, and which ones still need a decision or a second look in Vortex—all without re-running the matching process itself.
report-rulesgen.cardDesc: Check which mods have their rules copied, and which still need a decision.

report-workshop.name: Workshop Report
report-workshop.heroTitle: See When You Last Touched Each Workshop Collection
report-workshop.heroBody: Nexus's own collection page shows a date that never moves for a private collection—this pulls the real one, straight from each collection's revision history, so you can tell at a glance which ones you've actually worked on recently.
report-workshop.cardDesc: See when you actually last touched each Workshop collection, straight from Nexus.

report-mergehistory.name: Merge History
report-mergehistory.heroTitle: Check Merges for Re-enabled Original Files
report-mergehistory.heroBody: Compares your built merges against your active mod list. If a collection update re-enabled an original plugin or your merge went missing, fix your load order with a single click.
report-mergehistory.cardDesc: Review past merges, spot drifted plugins, and cleanly Revert or Restore them when your mod list changes.

report-mergeupdatereport.name: Merge Update Status Report
report-mergeupdatereport.heroTitle: Check Your Merges for Source Updates
report-mergeupdatereport.heroBody: Highlights mods updated in Vortex or via collection updates that affect your existing merges. It lists each updated mod, the new version, and which merged plugins contain outdated files, making it easy to rebuild and replace your older merge files.
report-mergeupdatereport.cardDesc: See which mods updated in Vortex or via a collection update, and which of your merges need a rebuild because of it.

report-exceptions.name: Mod Exceptions
report-exceptions.heroBody: Some mods are hand-pick-only installers where you deliberately chose a subset of what the archive contains. Auto-extracting or auto-rebuilding the full archive for one of these doesn't restore what's "missing" -- it installs content you never chose, which can cause missing masters or crashes. Add a mod here once, and both Rebuild Collection and Rebuild Missing Files will leave it alone from then on, wherever it shows up.
report-exceptions.cardDesc: See and manage the mods Rebuild Collection and Rebuild Missing Files should never auto-fix.

missing-masters.name: Missing Masters
missing-masters.heroBody: Easily pinpoint missing master files and instantly see every mod relying on them—all in one clear view! Designed to streamline your troubleshooting, this tool takes the hassle out of tracking down broken dependencies so you can get everything sorted with confidence.
missing-masters.cardDesc: Pinpoint missing master files and every mod that depends on them.

pgpatcher.name: PGPatcher Load Order
pgpatcher.heroTitle: Set Your Load Order With Drag-and-Drop
pgpatcher.heroBody: When two mods modify the same mesh or shader, your load order decides which one wins! This tool makes it easy to set that order exactly how you want it—drag mods around, multi-select to move batches together, or sort everything A–Z in one click. It works directly with your real PGPatcher setup and runs the authentic PGPatcher build engine underneath, so you get the same output files, logs, and modrules.json you'd get any other way—just with live progress tracking and instant reordering.
pgpatcher.cardDesc: Set your load order with drag-and-drop, multi-select, and A–Z sorting.

scrub.name: Mod Scrub
scrub.heroBody: Easily spot staging folders and archives that Vortex has quietly stopped tracking—no digging through anything by hand! Designed to take the guesswork out of cleanup, this tool shows you exactly what's safe to remove so you can reclaim disk space with confidence.
scrub.cardDesc: Spot staging folders and archives Vortex stopped tracking, and reclaim the space.

clear-update-flags.name: Clear Update Flags
clear-update-flags.heroTitle: Dismiss Accidental Update Flags in Seconds
clear-update-flags.heroBody: Accidentally clicked Check for Updates in Vortex and now your mod list is full of orange update badges? This tool clears those flags across your installed mods so your list goes back to a clean state. It's especially useful when playing curated collections, where the collection curator manages tested mod versions—saving you from seeing distracting update notifications for files you shouldn't update manually.
clear-update-flags.cardDesc: Dismiss false "Update Available" badges so you can stick with the exact mod versions your collection needs.

duplicate-version-cleanup.name: Duplicate Version Cleanup
duplicate-version-cleanup.heroBody: Placeholder hero copy — the whole thing (name, tagline, hero text) still needs a Gemini pass before this is final. What it actually does: Vortex's own Version dropdown can show the same mod more than once — sometimes a genuinely older archived version kept on purpose, sometimes a leftover orphaned download that's really just clutter. This tool finds every group, lets you tell them apart, and cleans up the real duplicates for good: remove, redownload, reinstall, replay any FOMOD choices, and reassign it back to every collection it belonged to.
duplicate-version-cleanup.cardDesc: Find every mod with more than one version showing in Vortex, tell the real duplicates apart from ones kept on purpose, and clean them up for good.

archive-finder.name: Archive Finder
archive-finder.heroTitle: Find Any File Inside Any Archive
archive-finder.heroBody: Stop extracting archives just to see what's inside! This tool indexes every zipped mod archive's contents up front—no unpacking needed—so you can instantly search across all of them by file or mod name, and pull out exactly the patch you need.
archive-finder.cardDesc: Search inside every mod archive without extracting a thing.

file-retriever.name: File Retriever
file-retriever.heroTitle: Download Specific Mod Files, Even Older Ones
file-retriever.heroBody: Nexus not letting you download a file? Is that archive not available? It is now. Enter a mod's Nexus ID, check off the exact files and versions you need -- including older, archived ones -- and download them straight to a folder of your choosing.
file-retriever.cardDesc: Enter a mod's Nexus ID and download specific files or older versions straight to your drive.

cycle-helper.name: Cycle Helper
cycle-helper.heroTitle: Pinpoint the Rule Actually Causing a Cycle
cycle-helper.heroBody: When Vortex reports a rule cycle after you've hand-edited your load-order rules, this points at the rule(s) actually responsible instead of dumping every mod caught in the tangle—fix it, apply it, and confirm the cycle's really gone, all in one place.
cycle-helper.cardDesc: Pinpoint the rule actually causing a Vortex cycle, fix it, and confirm it's really gone.

missing-files.name: Rebuild Missing Files
missing-files.heroTitle: Fix Just the Files That Are Actually Missing
missing-files.heroBody: Whether a Vortex removal wiped out shared files, staging folder mods went missing, or rebuilding an entire collection feels like overkill—this tool has you covered. It scans your collections, pinpoints missing files or archives, and restores only what you need directly from the local archive or a fresh download.
missing-files.cardDesc: Check your collections for missing staging files, then fix just the ones that need it.

settings.name: Settings
settings.heroTitle: Set It Up Once, Use It Everywhere
settings.heroBody: Set your Vortex paths and preferences here just once, and every tool picks them up automatically! Designed to keep all your setup in one place, this saves you from entering the same folders and options over and over—so you can spend your time on the actual work, not the configuration.

save-cleaner.name: Save Cleaner
save-cleaner.heroBody: When you remove mods, leftover scripts and orphan references stay baked into your save file—slowly piling up until your game stutters, crashes, or fails to load. This tool scans for leftover data, pinpoints the removed mods responsible, and purges the junk cleanly (with an automatic backup created first, every time).
save-cleaner.cardDesc: Find and clear out orphaned scripts left behind by mods you removed, with the real mod names attached.
